name: Dark Mark reduces nearby enemies' chance to hit (#2822)
contract: Dark Mark 705731 is a single aura 4 (SPELL_AURA_DUMMY) marker with BasePoints -1; its tooltip takes every number from 707375: 'Reduces the chance to hit for enemies within $707375a1 yds of you by $707375s1%.' 707375 is Effect 129 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_ENEMY with aura 54 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE, BasePoints -4 / DieSides 1 (i.e. -3) and RadiusIndex 8. No row in Spell.dbc triggers 707375 through EffectTriggerSpell, CasterAuraSpell, TargetAuraSpell or EffectMiscValue, and coa-obtainable --class 20 (222/222 identical between the shipped CharacterAdvancement.dbc and the live-client capture) reports advancement=none and live_capture=False for it, so nothing ever applied it. The talent's own marker now applies it. The radius is not hard-coded here: the enemy stands 3 yards away, inside any radius the record can carry.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The enemy carries no Dark Mark before the talent
Learning Dark Mark applies its area aura to the nearby enemy
The applied effect carries 707375's own -3% hit chance
